[EN] Have you seen Thulsa's Ksharan guards?

They seized the Ventral Command Center northeast of the furnace, and we can't retake the facility without dealing with them.

Kill off the Ksharan archpriests and vanguards and bring me their amulets. Think you can handle it, ?
[ES] ¿Has visto a los Ksharan guards de Thulsa?

Tomaron el Ventral Command Center al noreste del horno, y no podemos retomar las instalaciones sin lidiar con ellos.

Mata a los Ksharan archpriests y vanguards y tráeme sus amuletos. ¿Crees que puedas manejarlo, ?

[EN] I was right—I knew you'd make it!

We're one step closer to taking this place from the enemy. Nice work!
[ES] Tenía razón: ¡sabía que lo lograrías!

Estamos un paso más cerca de arrebatarle este lugar al enemigo. ¡Buen trabajo!

[EN] Bring me proof that you've defeated the Ksharans.

I know it's difficult, but I have great faith in you.
[ES] Tráeme pruebas de que has derrotado a los ksharans.

Sé que es difícil, pero tengo mucha fe en ti.
